[EN] Mission Orders

Monsters are wandering in Feldrin Ravine and proving dangerous to the locals.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:38#31#hungry ruins hyenas}, {@LinkCreature:38#38#prion destroyers} and {@LinkCreature:38#37#bonecrushers}.

Report to Slevene when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los monstruos deambulan por Feldrin Ravine y resultan peligrosos para los lugareños.

Mata a los {@LinkCreature:38#31#hungry ruins hyenas}, {@LinkCreature:38#38#prion destroyers} y {@LinkCreature:38#37#bonecrushers}.

Infórmale a Slevene cuando termines la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
